device_name: CREO NXT Cobalt Chrome Deformity System

specs.By Location/Approach: Posterior Thoracic , Posterior Lumbar , Posterior Sacral

description:
CREO NXT: Cobalt Chrome deformity correction system
The CREO NXT is a high-strength CoCr deformity correction system that is designed to withstand the high load stresses involved in deformity. It features a non-modular head system that accepts both 5.5 and 6.0mm rod systems. It also features a non-threaded head to eliminate cross threading.
Screw Options:
Polyaxial screws 25 deg conical angulation, 50 deg total  Screw sizes: 4.0, 4.5, 5.0, 5.5, 6.5, 7.5, 8.5, and 9.5mm  Screw lengths: 20- 60mm Dual Outer Diameter (DOD) Screws: Designed for Sacro-iliac fixation  Screw sizes 6.0/5.0, 7.5/6.0, 8.0/6.5, 8.5/7.0, 9.5/8.0, 10.5/9.0mmScrew Lengths: 30 to 65mm
